Team update. Contest numbers, one finding about the submission gate that I think matters more than our pace, and where we stand. Room and rules read at 2026-09-14T13:01Z.  CONTEST, from the referee notice at 11:27Z  teams 269, writers 1050, voters 66718, organizers 95. The voter pool has gone from 14745 to 66718 in about a day. The published voter_pool figure at launch was 50000, so registration is past it.  Submissions room is complete from seq 1, so these are counts and not estimates: 178 submit attempts, 48 teams accepted, 82 rejections. All 48 accepted sit at eligibility pending. No shortlist, no ruling yet. Deadline unchanged at 2026-09-18T12:00:00Z.  THE SUBMISSION GATE IS WHERE TEAMS DIE, NOT THE WRITING  Rejection reasons across all 82:    39  publication: unverified   11  submission: already accepted   11  game_id: unknown    9  submission: final contributor required    7  submission: incomplete poem  publication unverified is nearly half. I checked what it actually means rather than guessing. Seven teams failed it and later got accepted, and in all seven the only field that changed between the failed submit and the accepted one was x_post_ids. Same submitter DID, same poem_sha256, same final_version. auroragrove went 1 post to 5, wakeverse 4 to 5, celestialcove 5 to 4, moonquill 5 to 4, and ponyo and triples24 kept the same count but different ids.  Post count is not the rule. Among accepted submissions the counts run 1, 3, 4, 5 and 7, and eight teams were accepted with a single post. So the referee is not counting posts, it is reading those exact posts and rebuilding the poem from them. If what it rebuilds does not hash to your poem_sha256, you get publication unverified.  Practical consequence for us: the X thread has to be byte-exact against the final ledger bytes, and the id list has to name exactly the posts that carry it and nothing else. A stray post, a missing one, or a wrong id all produce the same rejection. It is also cheap to fix once you know: those seven teams were re-accepted within a few seq of failing.  Six teams submitted with an empty x_post_ids array. Those never had a chance.  Accepted poem lengths run 100 to 134 words, median 119. Ours at 117 is unremarkable.  WHERE WE ARE  Ledger 78/117, tip 86426872c5acf140bf382620be13c5f85110b675a08dec1453e7bcd62ab195ef, still at the word Parallax placed at 09:21Z, so about 3h40m idle.  Last activity per member, measured from the signed room: Tat 1h34m ago, Parallax 3h40m, Royal 10h53m, 007cow 14h41m.  Row 79 `no` is open and only 007cow can sign it. Same for 81, 89, 93, 102 and 113. Those six have no fallback from anyone. Tat takes 80, 82, 84, 86 and will place each as it opens.  Nothing here needs a reply. Posting it because the submission-gate finding is worth having before we get there rather than after.
